green_light_signals.trigger_phrase: We want something where somebody takes control and we are not involved other than paying a commission or whatever.
green_light_signals.context: Stated as their opening requirement before any figures were discussed -- matches Stayful's full-management, hands-off model almost word for word.

green_light_signals.context: Property is vacant, fully refurbished, and immediately lettable -- no tenancy, move, or purchase blocker; the only pending item is the furnishing quote itself.

green_light_signals.trigger_phrase: Interesting, you know, if your projections show that we can get that sort of income, you know, that's what we were looking at.
green_light_signals.context: The closest the lead came to a personal commitment signal on the call -- conditional but genuine interest in proceeding if the figures hold up.

meeting_flow.opening_phrase: I thought I'd start just by understanding your sort of current situation and situation with the property and interest, you know, in short letting. Then we can go through some figures in our service.
rapport_topics: previous tenant of 8 years, only 2-3 tenants across 15 years
proximity to Bristol Temple Meads and the city centre
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: Well, what I can do is I can share my screen and we can go through some of the income projections for you if you just give me a minute.
meeting_flow.income_intro: So we're looking at a net income of about 2400 pound per month. So that's average. And that's after basically all of the cost that we have.
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: Screen share failed entirely, so 'how it works' was answered reactively rather than as a planned transition -- in response to the lead's own question 'How does it work? ... do you pay us a fixed amount ... or does it vary?', Zac explained payout is on income actually received.
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: Based off of what we're, what we've discussed, I mean, does it look like it'd be of interest to you, or is it look like it's something that wouldn't work for you?
meeting_flow.close_phrase: I can send you a detailed sort of action plan slash summary of everything we've spoken about. I'll send over our agreement as well.
meeting_flow.meeting_2_ask: we could probably follow up sort of next week, have a call and go through it in a bit more detail

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Can I just ask, so what happens if it doesn't let for part of the month, or some month for some reason it doesn't let at all?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: We can only pay out on income that we receive... this is why we go through these projections with people, so they understand and are aware of all the risks that come with it.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: How does it work? So do we go by what you earn per month, or do you pay us a fixed, like, amount for the year less your commission, or does it vary?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: If you're wanting something that's stable but a much lower return, long-letting is the option... but in your position the risk is very, very low because you don't have any mortgage.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Other than paying the mortgage, we have to pay the bills. We don't have a mortgage on it. So which bills would that involve? ... 400 pounds per year?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Council tax, gas, electricity, water and Wi-Fi... probably around sort of 400 pound... per month.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: 400 pounds per year? (checking whether the figure was annual or monthly)

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Who pays the council tax on the flat? Does it count as a second home? ... the council tax is twice if it's your second home, a personal name.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: I would quite heavily advise putting it in a limited company because you can then apply for something that's called small business rates relief... it will lower your council tax bill to zero.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: So does it need any input from us? We don't need to go to the flat or do anything there?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: The property would need fully furnishing, we can do that for you... I'd need somewhere to pick the keys up from, and some photos of the property ahead of time so I can price something up.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: [garbled] ...reject the cat [guests] ... make sure they need when they come and go that way in the same condition
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: We do ID checks for every guest and we do security deposits as well... if we do have some kind of bad experience, or things stolen or broken, we claim our security deposit.

what_they_needed_most: confirmation of a fully hands-off arrangement
reassurance the property condition is protected

profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: Have a backup ready for screen-share failure before the call (e.g. pre-send the presentation link so the lead can follow along on their own device), and script the worst/best month figures precisely to avoid live misstatement.
